rachel-sales: Vela Systems POC stalled. CISO insists on temporary peering + short burst for tomorrow's exec demo. also need an exact demo spend cap.

tom-eng: We can do peering + KV warmup. what's the CIDR and demo window?

rachel-sales: CIDR 198.51.100.128/30. window 10:00-10:45 UTC. customer ok with up to $800 for the demo.

ben-ops: draft ACL below, will only allow /32s and TLS.

```
peering: vela-demo-01
from_tenant: redwood-demo-tenant
to_cidr: 198.51.100.128/30
allowed_ports: [443]
duration_hours: 2
egress_limit_mbps: 10
acl: ["198.51.100.129/32"]
logging_kms: "alias/vela-demo-logs"
```

nina-security: Conditions: logs to customer KMS alias, retention 30d, SSO read-only for reviewer. I can fast-track sign-off if ops posts final ACL.

infra-bot: [change-request] vela-demo-01 created by ben-ops. Runbook RB-20242.

ben-ops: staged config pushed. scheduling KV warmup 10min before window.

tom-eng: smoke test from restricted host: TLS ok, latency ~95ms with warm cache. fallback route set to hosted endpoint.

claire-csm: I approve $800 capped demo. will email procurement and customer PO note.

nina-security: Sign-off complete. conditions met. :white_check_mark:

ben-ops: teardown scheduled at 11:15 UTC. will post once reverted.

rachel-sales: thank you all 100. I'll update Vela and book the exec demo.

ben-ops: teardown complete; peering removed and egress limit reverted. closing thread.
